status_summary: EPA's 2025-03-25 news release says the Administrator directed the Office of Water to fast-track review and approval of state primacy under the Safe Drinking Water Act. EPA has since published final rules approving Arizona's primacy for all six injection well classes (2025-09-15, effective 2025-10-15), Texas's Class VI primacy (2025-11-14, effective 2025-12-15) and Colorado's Class VI primacy (2026-10-13, effective 2026-11-12); West Virginia's Class VI approval was published 2025-02-26. No executive order on primacy, no Clean Water Act section 404 assumption approval, and no coordination step with the Army Corps or Interior under such an effort were found.

timeline.event: EPA published a final rule approving West Virginia's Class VI well primacy.
EPA's news release reported the Administrator had directed the Office of Water to fast-track review of state Safe Drinking Water Act primacy applications.
EPA published a final rule approving Arizona's primacy for all six injection well classes.
EPA published a final rule approving Texas's Class VI primacy.
EPA published a final rule approving Colorado's Class VI primacy, effective 2026-11-12.
